start.title: Start
start.text: Welcome to the Official FishOnMC Wiki! This is the one-stop site for all things related to the game. Our goal is to provide you with the most up-to-date, accurate information relating to the game for any questions pondered. Thank you to our wonderful contributors for keeping the wiki material updated. Content View all related to fishing! Fishing View all related to fishing locations! Locations View all related to armor! fishing.title: Fishing
fishing.text: Fishing Fishing is the core of the game. As a result, there are many custom features that have been added in relation to fishing. Fishing Minigame Fishing Minigame Tutorial Sneak to increase line tension (make the blue bar go to the right). STOP sneaking to make it go down (left). When the green progress bar at the top is full, you have caught the fish! When the blue bar reaches the start or the end of the minigame, your fish will snap off. Tension Bar The blue bar below represents how the fish is fighting. Higher rarity fish will pull harder, thus making them more difficult to catch. If this bar reaches the end on either side, the line will snap and the fish will be lost. This bar is unaffected by the size of the fish. Progress The green bar above represents how close you are to catching the fish. Think of this bar like the health meter of the fish. Once you get this bar to 100%, the fish is caught. The weight of a fish directly affects how much progress is needed to reel in the fish. This bar is affected by natures and fishing stats , namely reel speed and line strength . Fish Natures Fish natures affect the behavior of the minigame, with some making it easier or more difficult. Nature Effect Calm Slightly easier Docile Fairly easier Relaxed Much easier Sassy Slightly harder Brave Fairly harder Hardy Much harder Hasty Rapid line, less frequent Impish Slow line, more frequent Jolly Stays closer to middle Lonely Stays away from middle Quirky Slower progress Timid Faster progress Fish Rarities Base chances for fish rarities, these can be increased with higher Luck . Rarity Odds Base Value ($ and XP) 55% 25 30% 50 10% 125 4% 250 1% 500 Fish Sizes Fish have different sizes that affect their sell price and XP . You can increase the chance for bigger fish with Scale . When the size tier of a fish is generated, it will then generate a length from within that tier's range for the specific fish. The weight is then determined from the neighborhood of that length. After this, any size bonuses from lures, armor rolls, or location rolls are added together and multiplied by the generated weight and length. These are the base odds for each size tier: Size Base Chance Size Range Value Multiplier ($ and XP) Baby 20% 0.20x - 0.25x 1x Juvenile 40% 0.25x - 0.35x 1x Adult 30% 0.35x - 0.55x 1.5x Large 9.98% 0.65x - 0.80x 2x Gigantic 0.02% 0.975x - 1.03x 5x Size Range is based off of the “maximum” length value of the fish.

locations.title: Locations
locations.text: Locations There are 16 unique fishing locations available on the server. Each one becomes accessible at specific player levels and features distinct water and climate types. All of which are based on real-life, well-known fishing destinations. View more information about them below! armor.title: Armor
armor.text: Armor Armor is one of the main methods of progression, providing stats and multipliers. There is one armor set for each climate with their stats only being applyed when in the corresponding climate . Shards Climate shards are used to craft and upgrade armor. Each climate has its own shard. They are obtained in a few ways, the simplest being a rare drop from fishing based on your Prospect . Hard Quests and placing top 3 in contests also reward shards for their respective locations. Unidentified Armor To craft armor, use /craft and follow vanilla Minecraft armor recipes (excluding helmets). Once crafted, armor will be unusable until it is identified at the Identifier NPC located to the left of spawn. Identifier Once you have made your unidentified armor, you will need to take it to the Identifier (or use the command /identifier if you are rank or higher). With the unidentified armor in the Identifier's Armor Slot, click the Identify button, and it will be given its quality, ranging from 1% to 100%. The quality value directly influences the armor bonuses you get from its stats. The higher the quality, the better the armor. Currently, an armor's percentage cannot be increased once it has been identified, so if you are not happy with what you got, you will need to make a new piece and try again. The unwanted pieces can be sold to other players on the Auction House ( /ah ) or brought to the Scrapper. Scrapper If you get a piece of armor with a quality you are unhappy with, you can take it to the scrapper behind the identifier (or use the command /scrapper if you are rank or higher). Doing this will give you shards back based on the percentage of the piece and the original crafting cost of the armor. The higher the percentage, the more shards you get back. Armor Piece 1% - 29% 30% - 39% 40% - 49% 50% - 74% 75% - 89% 90% - 94% 95% - 100% Chestplate 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 Leggings 1 1 2 3 4 5 6 Boots 1 1 2 2 2 3 3 Forge When you have a piece of armor with a quality you are happy with, recommended to aim for 90%+, you can upgrade its tier with shards in the forge located to the right of the scrapper at spawn (or use the command /forge if you are rank or higher). Increasing the tier increases the stats given by the armor, as well as unlocking another bonus for you to roll. The costs to upgrade are as follows: Current Tier Next Tier Shard Cost Total Cost from Common 16 16 48 64 96 160 256 416 Armor Bonus Rolls Each tier of armor gives it one bonus roll slot that gives the armor an added effect. To activate these bonuses, you right-click the armor in your inventory and click on one of the Empty Bonus slots. This turns it into an Active Bonus with a random percentage between 0.1% and 10%. Each slot gives a different type of bonus. You can click the active roll slot again, and it will re-roll the percentage and what bonus it gives you. However, re-rolling costs money, with it getting more and more expensive the more you roll. The amount it will cost does cap out at $25K . Below are the types of bonuses and max re-roll costs for each tier. Tier Bonus Type Max Re-roll Cost Size of Fish based on Group $25K Size of Fish based on Rarity $25K Size of Fish based on Lifestyle $25K Variant chance $25K Bonus fish Money or XP $25K Right clicking a bonus roll locks it, so it can't be accidentally rerolled. Bonus rolls can also be cleared by hovering over the roll and dropping the ender eye by pressing Q. You will then need to confirm this action. Supercharge Supercharges are a craftable item, using a lightning in a bottle and 8 location specific shards . To apply a supercharge, right click it onto a correlating climate armor piece to apply it, a supercharge will temporarily increase the armor piece's Luck , Scale and Prospect stats as well as the Tier 4 and 5 bonus rolls. There are 3 tiers of supercharges, starting at epic rarity. Visit the Forge NPC to tier up your climate-specific supercharge with correlating climate shards . Supercharge tier Cost Bonus Duration Crafing Recipe 8x Climate Shards , 1 Lightning in a bottle 1.1x Stats 500 Catches Forge with 24 Shards 1.25x Stats 1000 Catches Forge with 64 Shards 1.5x Stats 2500 Catches Lightning in a bottle Lightning in a bottle is obtained by fishing during a Thunderstorms and Supercells . There is a 1/250 chance of obtaining it when catching a fish while the Supercell is active, and a 1/500 chance when a Thunderstorm is active. Infusions Infusions are craftable items that when applied to an armor piece, give it a permanent increase to a specific stat based on the type of infusion it is. They are crafted in /craft using Infusion Capsules. To apply it, simply right click the crafted infusion onto the piece of armor in your inventory. Be careful, as this cannot be undone. tacklebox.title: Tacklebox
tacklebox.text: Tacklebox The tacklebox is a menu accessed by dropping your rod and selecting the tacklebox button. Baits & lures can be placed inside the tacklebox to be used while fishing (they are used up from top left to bottom right). Bait Packages Bait packages are obtained from location leveling, collection completion, contests , power rewards, and voting . Advanced Bait Packages include specific baits that cannot be found in Standard Bait Packages . The rarity of the bait packages determines the rarity distribution of their contents. Bait can be specific to Freshwater , Saltwater , a specific location or they can be universal. They can grant bonuses and debuffs for Bite Speed , Fish Likelihood & Fish weight/length. Stacking & Splitting bait When you have multiple of the same bait, grab one of the baits and right-click it onto the other to stack it in your inventory or tacklebox. When you want to split bait, hold the desired bait in your hand and type /splitter <amount> to split your bait into your desired amount. rodparts.title: Rod Parts
rodparts.text: THIS PAGE, AND ALL ROD PART PAGES, ARE CURRENTLY A WIP DUE TO BEING OUTDATED SINCE THE ROD PART UPDATE Rod Parts Rod Parts are an essential part of FishOnMC. There are three types of rod parts, Reels that increase Reel Speed , Poles that increase Bite Speed , and Lines that increase Line Strength . To create rod parts, visit the Artisan located at spawn. View all Reels! Reels View all Poles! Poles View all Lines! Lines Power Requirements Some Rod Parts have an associated Power Requirement to use them. If you do not have the required amount of Power , you can still use a part, but with less effectiveness. If you have 50% to 99.9% of the required Power , the part will be 50% effective. If you have 25% to 49.99% of the required Power , the part will be 25% effective. If you have 0 to 24.99% of the required Power , you will not gain any stats from the part. Rod Part Bonuses Rod parts can be enhanced in two different ways: by using tech and by calibrating them. Rod Tech Rod Tech is made at The Manufacturer and increases the stats of Poles and Reels by a percentage based on the rarity of the Tech used. There are two types of Rod Tech: The Blanks and The Gears. Blanks improve the stats of Poles, while Gears improve the stats of Reels. View all Blanks! Blanks View all Gears! Gears Rod Part Calibration Rod Parts, specifically Poles & Reels, can be calibrated at the calibrator NPC located at the Fish Pro Shops behind spawn (or use the command /calibrator if you are rank or higher). Calibrating When at the calibrator NPC, you can calibrate your reel or pole for money; the cost will vary based on the rarity of your rod part. When rolled, you will have a random chance to roll for some extra bonuses. pets.title: Pets
pets.text: Pets Pets are different animals from each location that you can catch and level up. Every location has a custom, location specific pet that can be used for a stat buff. Each pet has a rarity and a rating attached to it, which makes every caught pet unique. Only one pet can be equipped at once, whichever pet is equipped, will the one gaining levels while you fish. All pets come with 4 random stat boosts, 2 for scale as well as 2 for luck. One set of luck and scale that's climate bound, and another set that is location bound. For a common pet each extra stat will be ranged from 5 to 25, meaning a perfect common would have 25 on every stat. Pets Menu The pets menu can be accessed by right clicking on a pet while it is in the inventory. It has four uses: Pet skins , Pet Items , Pet Trails and Pet Merging. Pet Merging Pet merging allows you to combine two pets of the same rarity once they have both reached level 100 to form a new pet which is one rarity higher. Each stat is averaged between the two pets. The other ways to earn a pet are from Hard Quests , which have a 1/16 chance to drop a common pet when completed, and Contests with 3 or more people in when you place in the top 3. crews.title: Crews
crews.text: Crews Crews are player-based groups that you can create or join. With a crew, you gain access to a private island that can be accessed by /c go. You also get a Money and XP bonus (0.5% base) for fishing next to one of your crew members within a 10 block range. The command prefix for crews is /crew and can be shortened to /c. Here is a list of every crew command: Command Function /c create <name> Creates a crew, you must not be in a crew and have $15000 to create a crew. Crew names must be unique. /c invite <player> Invites a player to your crew; the player must not already be in a crew. /c join <crew name> Joins a crew; you must have received an invite to use this command. /c chat Toggles crew chat mode, messages that you send are in a channel with your crew members and not with the public. /c kick <player> Kicks a specified player from your crew. Crew Rank Lieutenant or Captain is required. /c delete Disbands and deletes your crew. Crew Rank Captain is required. /c [promote/demote] <player> Raises or lowers a player's rank by 1 from your crew. Works only going between Crew Rank Member and Lieutenant. The ranks in a crew go from Member > Lieutenant > Captain. /c info <player/crew name> Shows the crew's information. Same functionality with both /c stats <player/crew name> and /c. /c sethome Changes the crew island's spawn and looking direction. /c visit <crew name> Visits a crew that isn't yours. /c [go/home] Teleports you to your crew island. /c lock Toggles your crew island from being visited or not. Crew Rank Lieutenant or Captain is required. /c fly Toggles flying in your crew island. Members and Visitors can use this command. /c leave Leave your current crew. /c captain <player> Promotes a player to Crew Rank Captain. Crew Rank Captain is required. /cc <message> Will send you message in crew chat without toggling it. Leveling Crew missions are reset every day and give a large bonus to your crew leveling. Your crew xp additionally increases as you fish. Crew missions are the same for each crew on a given day. Mission Minimum Maximum XP Total 1500 2000 +25K 800 1100 +25K 600 850 +25K 250 360 +25K 150 250 +25K 100 150 +25K 2 3 +50K 2 2 +50K 1 1 +50K Gigantic 3 5 +50K Fish Group 75 150 +40K Every day, crews are assigned 1 Total mission, 3 Rarity missions, 1 Variant/Gigantic Mission, and 2 Fish Group Missions. Leveling increases the island border by 5 blocks per level up to level 20, another 5 blocks at level 25, and the last 5 blocks at level 30, for a total of 200×200 at crew level 30. The Money and XP bonus is increased by 0.5% every level up to level 10 for a maximum bonus of 5%. Every 5 levels, a new member slot is unlocked until the crew reaches 10 total members.

variants.title: Variants
variants.text: Variants With every catch, you have a chance to get a variant fish. Variant fish come with a different texture and are highly valuable due to the variant shards used in Rod Parts and Crafting Recipes. When catching a variant fish, a tag is shown at your bobber as you are playing the fishing minigame . Variant Base Chance Value Multiplier Shard Image Shard Name 1/5000 5x A l b i n o Shard 1/10000 10x M e l a n i s t i c Shard 1/15000 20x T r o p h y Shard 1/3000 During Fabled Events 30x Fabled Shard These variants have collection rewards , providing Money , Power , Bait Packages , and recipe unlocks. These variants have their own category per location compendium and give you Power on completion; the amount of power varies depending on the location. Variant Chance Variant Chance is a stat you can get to increase your odds of catching a variant fish. The ways to get this stat are from Reels , Poles , Rod Calibration , Legendary Armour rolls and Pet Items . The formula for how variant chance affects your odds is as follows: Albino: 1/( 5000/[1 + {Variant Chance/100}]) Melanistic: 1/(10000/[1 + [Variant Chance/100}]) Trophy: 1/(15000/[1 + {Variant Chance/100}]) Fabled: 1/( 3000/[1 + {Variant Chance/100}]) So this means that if you had +100% trophy chance your odds for a trophy would go from 1/15000 to 2/15000 (simplified to 1/7500). Event Variants Some events introduce unique variant fish. These variants can only be caught during the duration of the event and do not drop shards. fishing_stats.title: Fishing Stats
fishing_stats.text: Fishing Stats Reel Speed Reel Speed affects the amount of progress earned per successful tick in the fishing minigame. The base value is 0.6 “units” of progress. 1 Reel Speed is equivalent to 0.001 units, so +600 would be needed to double the base speed. Reel Speed is increased by upgrading your Reel . Bite Speed Bite Speed affects the wait time from when the bobber hits the water to when the fish's particles spawn in the water. The maximum wait time (20s by default) is displayed in your stats profile, and the minimum wait time is a quarter of the max. 1 Bite Speed is equal to 0.02 seconds off the max wait time and 0.005 seconds off the min wait time. The minimum wait time caps out at 1.5 seconds, and the maximum wait time caps out at 3 seconds. Bite Speed is increased by upgrading your Pole . Line Strength Line Strength affects the total progress needed to fill the fishing minigame bar. As Line Strength increases, the total progress needed is reduced, resulting in a faster catch time. Line Strength is increased by upgrading your line . Luck Luck increases the chance of catching higher rarity fish. Luck can be increased with Armor , Pets , and one of the generic location rolls. The rare rainbow event also provides +500 Luck for a short period. The luck formula is as follows: Rarity % Chance (0–2749 Luck) % Chance (2750–4722 Luck) % Chance (4723+ Luck) Common 55 - ( Luck * 0.02) 0% 0% Rare 30 + ( Luck * 0.002) 85 - ( Luck * 0.018) 0% Epic 10 + ( Luck * 0.004) 10 + ( Luck * 0.004) 95 - ( Luck * 0.014) Legendary 4 + ( Luck * 0.006) 4 + ( Luck * 0.006) 4 + ( Luck * 0.006) Mythical 1 + ( Luck * 0.008) 1 + ( Luck * 0.008) 1 + ( Luck * 0.008) Note: Any probability below 0% means that rarity can't be caught. Scale Scale increases the chance of catching higher size tier fish. Scale can be increased with Armor , Pets , and one of the generic location rolls. The scale formula is as follows: Rarity % Chance (0–1052 Scale) % Chance (1053–2222 Scale) % Chance (2223–4736 Scale) % Chance (4737+ Scale) Baby 20 - ( Scale * 0.019) 0% 0% 0% Juvenile 40 - ( Scale * 0.008) 60 - ( Scale * 0.027) 0% 0% Adult 30 + ( Scale * 0.008) 30 + ( Scale * 0.008) 90 - ( Scale * 0.019) 0% Large 9.98 + ( Scale * 0.018) 9.98 + ( Scale * 0.018) 9.98 + ( Scale * 0.018) 99.98 - ( Scale * 0.001) Gigantic 0.02 + ( Scale * 0.001) 0.02 + ( Scale * 0.001) 0.02 + ( Scale * 0.001) 0.02 + ( Scale * 0.001) Prospect Prospect increases the chance of getting shards from fishing. The base chance is 1/50. The formula for Prospect is Shard chance = 1/(50/[1 + { Prospect * 0.0008}]) Bonus XP Bonus XP multiplies the amount of player XP , location XP , and crew xp received when catching a fish. This is a separate multiplier from 2x XP Boosters. Bonus Money Bonus Money multiplies the amount of money received when catching a fish. This is a separate multiplier from 2x Money Boosters. It's important to note that this boost is only applied when the fish is caught , not sold . Pet Luck Pet Luck increases the chance to catch a pet. The formula is as follows: Rarity Formula 1/(750/[1 + Pet Luck/100]) 1/(4000/[1 + Pet Luck/100]) 1/(10000/[1 + Pet Luck/100]) 1/(30000/[1 + Pet Luck/100]) 1/(80000/[1 + Pet Luck/100]) So if you had +100% pet luck your odds for a mythic pet would go from 1/80000 to 1/40000.

fishing_menu.title: Fishing Menu
fishing_menu.text: Fishing Menu Opening your fishing fishing menu with the book in your 9th hotbar slot, you will open the fishing menu. In the fishing menu there are a few buttons: Fishing Menu Image Name Information Daily Cosmetic Store Here you can view your daily cosmetics , purchase credits to buy skins . Can be rerolled with ranks . Recipes Here you can view custom item recipes. Fish Compendium Here you can view your personal fishing codex, view fish data and location leveling info. Quests Here you can view you quests in the location you are at, also done by doing /quests . Turbo Travel Travel to a location from everywhere, requires atleast to use this, otherwise use the locations NPC . Cosmetics Here you can view all your unlocked & locked cosmetics . Crews Here you can view info about your current crew. Shop Here you can purchase blocks to build with on your crew island. Crafting Here you can access a workbench to craft with building blocks bought from the shop, as well as your unlocked Recipes. Player profile Here you can access your profile to view you current stats, equipped items, collections, achievements and profile displays. Help Here you can open the /help screen and see lots on information about the game systems. Settings Here you can toggle the side Scoreboard and Ambient sounds on or off. Daily Missions Here you can view your Daily Missions and your progress towards completing them.

quests.title: Quests
quests.text: Quests Quests are missions you activate per location that give rewards for catching fish based on size or rarity. When starting a quest you will be asked to select either an EASY , MEDIUM or HARD quest, and then you select whether you want the quest to be for Adult , Large , Rare , Epic or Legendary fish ( EASY quests can not be for Legendary fish). The amount of fish you need to catch as well as the rewards you get scale with both player level and location level. You access the Quest Menu by going into the Fishing Menu and clicking quests. You can also access it by typing /quests , /quest or /q . Once there, click on an open quest slot and choose the tier of quest you want to start. Everyone starts with 3 quest slots. The only way to increase this is by purchasing ranks . Each rank increases the number of slots by 1, up to a total of 8. You can abandon the quest you are given by clicking on the active quest slot and choosing abandon. This costs some money but can be beneficial in order to speed up questing, as you might get an easier quest to complete. There are three tiers of quests, each giving better rewards than the last. The difficulty of quests increase with level. Tier Level Unlocked Abandon Cost Rewards Easy 0 $750 $ xp lxp Medium 20 $1.5k $ xp lxp Hard 50 $4k $ xp lxp 1-2x Climate Shard Pet (1/16 Chance)

cosmetics.title: Cosmetics
cosmetics.text: Cosmetics There are six types of cosmetics in FishOn: TAGS , ROD SKINS , MINIGAME GRAPHICS , TRAILS , HATS & ROD TITLES . There are many ways to obtain cosmetics. Daily Cosmetic Store The Daily Cosmetic Store is a store that can be accessed at spawn, through the /store command or through the Fishing Menu . Certain ROD SKINS and HATS can be purchased here for credits . This store refreshes every 24 hours at 12:00am UTC. Some ranks give the player the ability to reroll the store a certain amount of times per day. Ranks Certain ROD SKINS and all TRAILS are unlocked through having ranks . The higher the rank , the more cosmetics unlocked. Location Levels Each location unlocks a ROD TITLE at Level 10, as well as a ROD SKIN at level 15. Cypress Lake also grants an additional ROD TITLE at Level 2. Compendiums Completing normal fish compendiums unlocks a TAG for each location. Events Limited Time Events grant many cosmetic rewards including TAGS , ROD SKINS , MINIGAME GRAPHICS , HATS and ROD TITLES . Collections Obtaining level 7 collections for each variant unlocks a trident themed ROD SKINS .

collections.title: Collections
collections.text: Collections Collections are fishing related milestones that provide rewards, including money, power, items, and recipe unlocks. There are two types of collections, Fish Collections and Species Collections . To access collections, perform /collections or navigate through the fishing menu.

contests.title: Contests and Tournaments
contests.text: Contests and Tournaments Contests Contest Announcement FishOnMC has fishing contests that happen once every hour, on the hour. In a fishing contest the challenge is to catch an as big as possible fish of the fish group that the contest asks for. The contests last 30 minutes and the top 3 fishermen with the biggest fish receive varying rewards. Rewards Contest participants are divided into groups based on level. every weekend from Friday at 18:00 UTC to Monday at 18:00 UTC, a tournament is held. They can be hosted in any location; however, only a select few fish can be chosen (any mythical and select gamefish in other rarity ranges). It is decided based on a wheel spin held in the FishOnMC Discord . To access the tournament screen, use /tournament . In a tournament, you only have a limited number of catches (2.5k) at the location to fill the 5 slots in your bag with the biggest possible catches of the target species. Most tournaments are in weight; however, some fish are counted by length. Catches of the target species are automatically recorded in your bag. When you catch a bigger fish than one already in your bag, it replaces the smallest of the 5 with the new bigger one. You can disable contributions so you can fish at the location without it counting toward your limit. However, if you catch one of the target fish, it will not be counted in your bag. There are 5 Tournament Brackets: Beginner (Levels 0-29), Intermediate (Levels 30-89), Advanced (Levels 90-149), Master (Levels 150+), and Global (ALL). Tournament Series A tournament series is a competitive event comprised of 4-8 tournaments over 2 months. When you compete in a tournament, alongside the placement reward you receive in your level bracket, you also receive trophies based on your Global placement. The amount of trophies collected over the tournaments in a series determines your Grand Tournament Rewards. events.title: Fishing Events
events.text: Fishing Events There are two types of events within FishOn: Reoccurring Events & Limited Time Events. Reoccurring Events Weather Events Rain Shower A Rain Shower can start randomly every 1 to 2 hours and lasts between 450 and 600 seconds. It gives +50 Bite Speed . While it is raining, the weather icon at the top of the screen turns to a ☂ symbol. Thunderstorms and Supercells Thunderstorms spawn 1 in 3 times when it starts to rain and grants +100 bite speed as well as a 1/500 chance to fish up a Lightning in a Bottle . These last between 300 and 680 seconds. A Supercell is a buffed version of the Thunderstorm and happens 1 in 15 times that it starts to rain. This storm gives +150 bite speed and the chance for a Lightning in a Bottle is 1/250. These last between 250 and 540 seconds. While a storm is active, the weather icon at the top of the screen turns to a ⚡︎ symbol. Rainbows Rainbows have a 1 in 4 chance to spawn after it stops raining granting +500 luck and lasts betwen 180 and 420 seconds. Moon Events Moon Events occur every full moon (Once every 8 Minecraft days or 160 minutes) and last for 600 seconds. Name Effect Weather Icon Full Moon +120 Bite Speed ⭘ Blue Moon +120 Bite Speed 5x XP ⭘ Super Moon +120 Bite Speed +150 Reel Speed ⭘ Blood Moon +120 Bite Speed 1/300 chance for an Infusion Capsule ⭘ Unique Events Unique Events happen every 1 to 2 hours. Gold Rush The Gold Rush Event changes the base rate of climate shards from 1/50 to 1/25. It also enables the chance to fish up the Prospecting Amulet at a 1/1000 chance. The Gold Rush lasts for between 900 and 960 seconds. While the Gold Rush is active, the weather icon at the top of the screen turns to a ⚠ symbol. Blooming Oasis The Blooming Oasis Gives +100% pet luck for between 900 and 960 seconds. While the Oasis is active, the weather icon at the top of the screen turns to a ♣ symbol. Fabled Event The Fabled Event happens twice per day, enabling Fabled Variant fish to be caught at a 1/3000 chance in a location declared in chat. Only one person per fabled event can catch the Fabled Fish . While the Fabled Event is active, the weather icon at the top of the screen turns to a ★ symbol. Location Specific Events Cryptid Sighting at Cypress Lake When fishing at Cypress Lake between the in game hours of 1am and 3am, there is a 1/300 chance that Bigfoot will steal your fish. This means that instead of catching a fish, you instead get either a Bigfoot Tooth or a Bigfoot Fur. These can be used to craft some pet items . Limited Time Events Limited-time events happen seasonally and are each unique. They grant many rewards for reaching thresholds and advancing on the leader board. Completing event milestones would reward limited cosmetics . Winter Event 2025 The 2025 winter event started on 02/22/2025 and lasted until 03/01/2025. The event revolved around catching a new fish variant called fish. Every salmon in Kenai River had a 1/50 base chance to be a variant. Sawfish Event 2025 The 2025 Sawfish event started on 04/19/2025 and lasted until 04/26/2025. The event revolved around catching the Smalltooth Sawfish . The base chance of catching one of these notorious fish was 1/100 when catching any fish in Key West . Using the Stone crab bait increased your chances of catching this fish. Meanmouth Bass Event 2025 The 2025 Meanmouth Bass event started on 06/28/2025 and lasted until 07/06/2025. The event revolved around catching the Meanmouth Bass in the Great Lakes . The base chance of catching one of these hybrid fish was 1/40 whenever you would have caught either a Smallmouth Bass or a Largemouth Bass at Great Lakes . Shark Week Event 2025 The 2025 Shark Week Event started on 07/20/2025 and lasted until 07/26/2025. The event revolved around catching the Common Remora and a new fish variant called sharks . The base chance of catching a Common Remora was 1/50 on any catch in Key West , Cape Cod or Cairns . The chance of a Shark being an variant was 1/50. Halloween Event 2025 The 2025 Halloween Event started on 10/31/2025 and lasted until 11/07/2025. The event revolved around catching a new fish variant called fish. Every fish in Cypress Lake had a 1/50 base chance to be a variant, With the Creepy Crawlers Bait increasing the odds. Christmas Event 2025 The 2025 Christmas Event started on 12/27/2025 and lasted until 01/03/2026. The event revolved around catching a new fish variant called fish. Every fish had a 1/50 base chance to be a variant, With the Frozen Crawlers Bait increasing the odds. Hanami Event 2026 The 2026 Hanami Event started on 04/11/2026 and lasted until 04/18/2026. The event revolved around catching Koi fish in Lake Biwa . When you caught a Common Carp in Lake Biwa , you had a chance to instead reel in a Koi. The odds were: 1/20 for Kohaku Koi , 1/50 for Showa Koi , and 1/200 for Tancho Koi . Shark Week Event 2026 The 2026 Shark Week Event started on 07/26/2026 and lasted until 08/02/2026. The event revolved around catching the Great Hammerhead . The base chance of catching a Great Hammerhead was 1/80 on any catch in Key West or Cairns With the Southern Ray Cutbait Bait increasing the odds. auction_house.title: Auction House
auction_house.text: Auction House Auction House All players have access to the auction house with the command /ah . On the auction house, players can list the items they want to sell. To list an item on the auction house, hold the item in your hand and do /ah sell <sell price> . When listing an item on the auction house, you will have to pay a 2% tax on the selling price of the item. A listed item will be on the auction house for 24 hours. If not sold, you can retrieve it by doing /overflow .

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.text: Frequently Asked Questions How do I get started? You can use the command '/tasks' to see a quick tutorial which will give you the rundown on the basics of the gameplay loop. How do I identify my armor? To identify your armor, Head to the spawn and look left. The Identifier is located to the left, right behind the Help NPC. Once at the Identifier, right click the NPC and click the armor piece you would like to identify, and then click the Ender Eye to identify your armor piece. How do I craft new rod parts? To craft new rod parts, Head to the Artisan. The Artisan is located at spawn right behind the cosmetics on the left side. Once at the Artisan, right-click the NPC and click an empty minecart. Click the rod part you would like to craft, and it should show you the Build Requirements and the time it will take to craft the part. How do I use my Bait/Lure? To use your Bait/Lure, right-click your rod in your inventory (or hold your rod in your hand and press your drop key) and click Tackle Box. Once you click Tackle Box, you can put the Bait/Lure in, and it will be used starting from Left to Right. How do I tier up my armor? To tier up your armor, head to the Forger at spawn. The Forger is located behind the Identifier and to the right of the Scrapper. Once at the Forger right click the NPC and click the armor piece you wish to tier up, once you click the armor piece hover over the axe and it will show you the requirements to tier up said armor piece, once ready and meet the requirements click the axe and your armor piece will tier up to the next level.

This location is home to the town of Cypress Lake, which serves as the main village of the server. Many important NPCs are hosted here and have visible homesteads. Around the 1800s, they built ceremonial centers and maintained far-reaching trade routes they used to trade fish they had caught. Spreading across 27,000 acres, Caddo Lake is a maze of waterways and wetlands, protecting and nurturing hundreds of unique species. location:kenai_river.title: Kenai River
location:kenai_river.text: Kenai River Location Kenai River Level 5 Climate Subarctic Pet Bear Region South-Central Alaska Inspiration Kenai River, Alaska Kenai River Kenai River is the second unlockable location of FishOnMC . This location has the longest river of southcentral Alaska, it harbors a small fishing village, Port Moosehorn, which various locals call home. Many of the locals can be interacted with. Real Life History The Kenai River has a long history of fishing traditions. Long before crowds of people came to the lower rivers to chase salmon, there was a salmon and trout fishery around Cooper Landing. Tribes have relied on the river's resources for sustenance and cultural practices. With constructions over time that improved access to the river, fishing activity increased, and by the late 20th century Kenai River became famous for its record-sized king salmon. This lured in even more fishermen worldwide, who contributed to the local economy. The Murray-Darling river system is the longest in Australia. It flows through New South Wales, Victoria, and South Australia, shaping the land and its people for thousands of years. Real Life History The Murray River has been an important location to the local communities for ages, providing a large number of Murray cods, perch, and crayfish. Fishing in the Murray River has been rooted in the local culture with its close communities, which rely on the fishermen for their needs. The best catches were sold or traded for other supplies, which reinforced the river's crucial role for their needs and traditions. However, overfishing after the European explorations in the 1800s almost led to the extinction of the Murray cods. location:everglades.text: Everglades Location Everglades Level 20 Climate Savanna Pet Marsh Rabbit Region Southern Florida Inspiration Everglades National Park, Florida Everglades Everglades is the 5th unlockable location in FishOnMC . Sometimes called the “River of Grass,” this location is a vast and swampy basin filled with extreme biodiversity. Real Life History The Everglades has been a fishing hub for ages. Native tribes relied on the water for their food, mostly consisting of bass and catfish. European settlers had created larger boats, and by the 1900s, the Everglades became a popular spot for sport fishing. On December 6th, 1947, Everglades officially became a United States National Park and has around 1.5 million acres of protected land. Today, the Everglades remains a top fishing spot, attracting fishermen from all over the world, while still preserving its traditions and history. location:great_lakes.title: Great Lakes
location:great_lakes.text: Great Lakes Location Great Lakes Level 50 Climate Continental Pet Eagle Region Canadian-American region Inspiration Lake Superior Great Lakes Great Lakes is the 8th unlockable location of FishOnMC . The Great Lakes are the largest group of freshwater lakes in the world. The total surface is around 95,000 square miles. They lie on the Canada & United States border and it has five interconnected lakes: Lake Erie, Lake Huro, Lake Michigan, Lake Ontario and Lake superior. Real Life History The Great Lakes have been of great use to Native American tribes for thousands of years. Many people wrote about the abundance of monstrous-sized fish fished up from the Great Lakes. Due to this, the lakes suffered from overfishing, and because of this, as of today, 61 fish species in the Great Lakes are considered to be threatened or endangered. Thanks to the Great Lakes Fishery Commission, the Great Lakes remain a treasured Canadian and United States fishery, and to this day, they still attract millions of fishermen. The lakes continue to provide jobs, recreation, and food. location:danube_river.title: Danube River
location:danube_river.text: Danube River Location Danube River Level 60 Climate Continental Pet Wolf Region Central Europe Inspiration Danube River, Esztergom, Hungary Danube River Danube River is the 9th unlockable location of FishOnMC . This location is the second-longest river in Europe with a length of 1,770 miles. Danube passes trough 10 countries, this is more than any other river worldwide. Real Life History Danube River is a great romping ground for fishermen, it has long gravel bars that offer Danube’s fish sufficient opportunities to lay eggs, and side-arms of the Danube extending into authentic river wetlands. Fishing in the Danube River still holds an important economic value and provides loads of cultural activity. However, commercial fishing on the Danube has gotten less popular due to overfishing. Local fishermen continue to fish in the Danube River. location:oil_rig.title: Oil Rig
location:oil_rig.text: Oil Rig Location Oil Rig Level 65 Climate Savanna Pet Pelican Region Gulf of Mexico Inspiration Gulf of Mexico Rig-to-Reef conversion Oil Rig Oil Rig is the 10th unlockable location of FishOnMC . Oil Rigs are large structures built in order to extract petroleum and natural gasses from below the seabed. Real Life History The United States portion of the Gulf of Mexico has the largest concentration of offshore platforms in the world, totaling more than 4500 of them. By 2000, 151 platforms had been converted into permanent reefs instead of being removed once the rigs had been abandoned. This was done to allow for the metal frames to house all sorts of marine life by giving shelter where there wasn't any before. location:amazon_river.title: Amazon River
location:amazon_river.text: Amazon river Location Amazon River Level 70 Climate Rainforest Pet Capybara Region South America Inspiration Amazon Basin, Peru Amazon River Amazon River is the 11th unlockable location of FishOnMC . This location, one of the longest rivers in the world, is around 4,000 miles long. However, due to its complex river system, most of which is in remote areas, it is unclear where the river starts and ends. Real Life History Fishing is the single most important food source in the Amazon Basin. The fishing industry has produced up to 1 million tons per year in Brazil, which is about half the country's fish production. Being the most important source of food, tribes use a wide variety of fishing tools to secure their catches, like nets, harpoons, and bow & arrow. When technological advancements were made, gillnets became the new go-to fishing tool and are still used to this day. location:mediterranean_sea.title: Mediterranean Sea
location:mediterranean_sea.text: Mediterranean Sea Location Mediterranean Sea Level 80 Climate Mediterranean Pet Lynx Region North Africa, Southern Europe, West Asia Inspiration Mediterranean Sea, Europe-Africa Mediterranean Sea Mediterranean Sea is the 12th unlockable location of FishOnMC . The Mediterranean Sea covers an area of about 970,000 square miles, making it 0.7% of the worlds ocean surface. Real Life History The Mediterranean Sea is known for its biodiversity and is home to over 17 thousand different fish, with around 30% being unique to this region. Despite its ecological importance, the Mediterranean Sea has around 75% of its fish overexploited, and since 1950, almost half of its top predators have been eliminated from the region. The Mediterranean Sea has a long fishery tradition, which has increased the amounts of fish caught by fishermen over the past centuries. After new inventions such as motorized boats, combined with the overfishing and poor management of the sea. The fish populations of the Mediterranean Sea have suffered greatly. location:hawaii.title: Hawaii
location:hawaii.text: Hawaii Location Hawaii Level 100 Climate Savanna Pet Dolphin Region Oʻahu Regions, United States Inspiration Haunama Bay, Hawaii Hawaii Hawaii is the 15th unlockable location of FishOnMC . This Location is the only US state completely made up of islands. It is made up of 137 islands, yet only 7 of them are inhabited. Real Life History The Hawaiian fishing industry was shaped by fish markets and fisheries. Many Japanese immigrants who were skilled commercial fishermen lived in Hawaii and turned to the sea to make a living. In the early 20th century, the fishing industry was widely impacted due to new laws to preserve local fish resources. Today, annual catch limits are put in place for specific fish or coral for commercial fisheries on the Hawaiian islands. shards.title: Shards
shards.text: Shards Shards are a crafting component used to craft and upgrade various items. There are currently two types: Climate shards and variant shards. Climate Shards These can be used to craft and upgrade armor sets, and are specific to each climate. The recipes are the same as vanilla, requiring 19 shards for a full set. Climate shards come from a few different sources. The most basic is as a rare drop when fishing, with a base chance of 1/50 that can be increased with Prospect . Contests also reward shards for their respective climate to the top 3. First awards 6, second awards 3, third awards 2. The most effective way of gathering shards is from hard Quests , which reward 1-3 per completion. Variant Shards These are currently used for Artisan crafting, Pet Item recipes and Infusion recipes. A single shard is guaranteed to drop whenever a variant fish is caught. List of Variant Shards Shard Shard Name Rarity A l b i n o Shard M e l a n i s t i c Shard T r o p h y Shard Fabled Shard

npcs:identifier.title: Identifier
npcs:identifier.text: Identifier The Identifier The identifier NPC is located directly East of spawn. Unidentified armor pieces can be brought to this NPC to get them identified . This NPC can be accessed remotely by players ranked or higher using the command /identifier .

ranks.title: Ranks
ranks.text: Ranks There are five ranks that can all be purchased through /buy . They give the player certain benefits as listed below. https://store.fishonmc.net Rank Price $9.99 $19.99 $39.99 $74.99 $149.99

npcs:scrapper.title: Scrapper
npcs:scrapper.text: Scrapper The Scrapper The Scrapper NPC, located East of spawn behind the Identifier , is an NPC which allows players to scrap armor pieces for shards . The number of shards the player gets back depends on the quality of the armor piece. NOTE: Higher tiered armor pieces cannot be scrapped. Players ranked or higher can access the Scrapper using the command /scrapper .

npcs:forge.title: Forge
npcs:forge.text: Forge The Forge The Forge NPC can be found directly East of spawn. This NPC allows the player to upgrade armor & lightning in a bottle pieces to the next tier using shards. Players ranked rank or higher can use the command /forge to access the NPC remotely

npcs:artisan.title: Artisan
npcs:artisan.text: Artisan The Artisan The Artisan, located South-east at spawn, is an NPC used to craft Rod Parts . When having the rank or above, you have permission to use /artisan to access it remotely. Rod Parts are unlocked by leveling up collections

pet_skins.text: Pet Skins Pet skins are cosmetic items only earned during a limited time event or having them gifted by the server owner. npcs:pet_store.title: Pet Store
npcs:pet_store.text: Pet Store The Pet Store The Pet Store, located to the east of spawn (to the left), is an NPC used to sell unwanted pets that are below excellent for money . The higher the rating and rarity, the more money you receive. Pet Prices Below are some prices for different Rarities and Ratings: Pet rarity Sickly (20%) Below Average (30%) Average (40%) Good (50%) Great (60%) Great (70%) $156.25 $312.5 $625 $1,250 $2,500 $5,000 $312.5 $625 $1,250 $2,500 $5,000 $10,000 $625 $1,250 $2,500 $5,000 $10,000 $20,000 $1,250 $2,500 $5,000 $10,000 $20,000 $40,000 $2,500 $5,000 $10,000 $20,000 $40,000 $80,000 The formula for the sale price of a pet is as follows: Price = (5000*2^[10*{Rating-0.7}])*Rarity Where Rating is a decimal (e.g. 50% is 0.5), and Rarity is how many commons merge into it. So Common = 1, Rare = 2, Epic = 4, Legendary = 8, and Mythic = 16.

npcs:tackle_shop.title: Tackle Shop
npcs:tackle_shop.text: Tackle Shop The Tackle Shop The Tackle Shop NPC is located in the Tackle Shop within the Bass Pro Shop behind spawn. At the Tackle Shop, you can buy up to 7 unique baits or lures . These are refreshed every 4 hours, including the quantities of the available tackle . The price of the bait scales based on quantity and rarity. Bait & Lure Rarities When the shop refreshes, it will sell new baits or lures . The rarity of the tackle is determined at the time of the refresh. The chances are as follows: 60% 28.9% 10% 1% 0.1% Variant lures are possible to obtain through the tackle shop. Quantity of Tackle After the rarity of the baits or lures is determined, the quantity available for each is also decided. The chances for the quantities are as follows: Quantity Chances 25-50 75% 50-75 20% 75-125 4% 200-300 0.3% 300-400 0.6% 400-500 0.09% 500-750 0.01%
